integrity: The target theorem and proof were inspected in the full open-access article. The counterexample is an exact two-dimensional calculation; the homogeneity reduction, commutation criterion, and sharp one-atom bound are proved symbolically. Earlier same-author preprints were checked to distinguish the 2018 nonhomogeneous theorem from their 2016 homogeneous perturbation results.
scientific_limitations: The sharp quantitative bound concerns ordinary Besselness and uses an ordinary Bessel bound of the reference family. The stronger controlled conclusion requires commutation of the control with the perturbed frame operator; no lower frame bound for the perturbed family is claimed.
title: Homogeneity exposes the control obstruction in a \(K\)-frame perturbation theorem
